Accomplishment

1. 亞太裔社區領袖獎API Heritage Leadership Award by Senator Wieckowski, June 12, 2015

2. Assembly Majority Leader Alberto Torrico 20th Assembly District Castro Valley Local Hero Resolution No. 38 Awarded to Cossette Sun on December 11, 2008

3. Marian Gould Gallagher Distinguished Service Award for Contribution to American Association of Law Libraries (AALL)

Publication(Non-professional ones)

1. Co-authoring "A Bibliography: The Published Works of Albert A. Ehrenzweig," 62 California Law Review 1080

2. Moderated the program "Getting What You Want: Working Effectively with Design and Construction Professionals" at the 1995 Annual Meeting of the American Association of Law Libraries in Pittsburgh.

Hobby

In Retirement, Workout at the gym and occasionally spend time with grandchildren. Attend board meetings at League of Women Voters; Attend community meetings.

Facebook, LinkedIn and Twitter
